title: When the Ringing Stops: Purely Imaginary Modes in the Ringdown Spectrum of Dynamical Black Holes
summary: We extend the frequency-domain analysis of quasinormal modes in a dynamical, spherically symmetric black hole spacetime undergoing constant-rate mass evolution. In particular, we report a novel feature of the spectrum: the presence of purely imaginary eigenvalues in addition to the usual light-ring modes. We study the frequencies of these modes both analytically and numerically. The analytical calculation uses a novel formalism based on recent advances in connection coefficients of Heun functions.
